messages.subject: Change Account Name

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Change Account Name
parts:
Account names can not be changed. However you can go to https://www.shinyapps.io/register and create a second account with whatever name you like. You will then have to register your account by running. Using your existing token and secret.

shinyapps::setAccountInfo("new account", token=... , secret=...)

Please keep in mind that once you have two accounts you need to use the account parameter when deploying your applications:

deployApp(account="new account")

Cheers
-Andy

You are using Google to login, you should be to select which account to associate with ShinyApps, if you are logged in to more then one Gmail account. The other option would be to use revoke ShinyApps.io access from your gmail account going to:

Logging in to ShinyApps will then prompt to select a gmail account.

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Change Account Name
parts:
Authentication in ShinyApps is tied to your Google account. A google account can not be associated with more then one ShinyApps user. However, a ShinyApps user can have more then one Account (think of Accounts as similar to organizations in GitHub).

For example:

I have a ShinyApps user (an...@rstudio.com) tied to my Gmail account (also an...@rstudio.com).

However my user has multiple ShinyApps accounts:

andy.shinyapps.io
andy2.shinyapps.io
demos.shinyapps.io
gallery.shinyapps.io

I can deploy to any of these accounts by running:

deployApp(account="andy2")

Because of this feature, there is no reason to have more then one ShinyApps user (but it is possible if you have more then one Gmail account).

-Andy
